notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3175950/Ezrebeth][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188600/59dbc37ccb8dd49ae522bacc8e04001b33b361d5.png[/img][/url]

[b]Rise and shine, Dwellers![/b]

[b]Ezrebeth[/b] is finally [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3175950/Ezrebeth]here[/url]!

Experience the most surreal [b]Tymedust Games[/b] story yet, offering a time-bending narrative of truly memorable proportions...

[i]“Many twists and turns, with a lot of depth to the characters.”[/i]
- [b]Hidden Gem Discovery[/b]

[i]“An intriguing and unusual story, gripping with its superb writing and distinctive artwork. Highly recommended.”[/i]
- [b]Critiques Sans Frontiers[/b]

[i]“An overall display of tragedy, the clash of humane and inhumane, love and inability to love, mundane and the divine, and the great incompatibility of the two options.”[/i]
- [b]User Review[/b]

We've also put together two bundles at reduced price points if you're looking to complete your collection of games and soundtracks from us: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51431/Pitstop_in_Purgatory__Ezrebeth_Duo_Pack]Pitstop in Purgatory + Ezrebeth Duo Pack[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51432/Purgatoryverse_Complete_Pack]Purgatoryverse Complete Pack[/url].

Thank you so much everyone for your support, and we hope you'll enjoy this brand new story of ours!

[i][b]All the love,
Tymedust Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Poetry in Purgatory DEMO available NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Rise and shine, Dwellers![/h1]

We're beyond excited to share that the [b]demo[/b] for [b]Poetry in Purgatory[/b] is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704840/Poetry_in_Purgatory/#game_area_purchase]now available[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780352/f6d8b513fa733f2a3ac8dfb594be540cc8934cbd.png[/img]
Weighing in at almost [i]100 000 words[/i], the demo is quite large and very replayable, offering branching morality choices, two love interests, three optional side stories and much more. You'll be able to get a pretty clear picture of what the full game will bring, along with brand new features such as the [b]PurgaPhone[/b] (send and receive messages to/from your friends and foes in Purgatory) and the [b]quest log[/b] (no more wondering where to go next).

[i]In addition, the full game will allow you to restore your progress, should you not want to replay everything from the beginning![/i]

We want to make this game as special as it can possibly be, so we'd love to hear your thoughts and impressions over in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2704840/discussions/]community hub[/url] if you decide to try out the demo. :)

[b]And as always, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704840/Poetry_in_Purgatory/#game_area_purchase]wishlisting[/url] the game helps us out a [i]ton[/i]![/b]

Have yet to take the plunge into the world of [b]Purgatory[/b], or perhaps you're itching to bring a friend into the afterlife at a reduced cost? [i]We've got you covered[/i]! 

[b]Pitstop in Purgatory[/b] is currently [i]30% off[/i] as part of [b]Steam's 2024 Summer Sale[/b]! Don't miss the chance to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2077080/Pitstop_in_Purgatory/]go buy it[/url] if you haven't already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780352/2d123c1c25bd884a623ce8e83ca5d3cdcdf8ca34.png[/img]
Looking for a short, surreal experience set face-to-face with the one and only [b]The Guide[/b]? [i]We know some of you certainly do.[/i] Then perhaps you'll enjoy [b]Guidelicious[/b], an absolutely [b]free[/b] micro game set in the world of [b]Purgatory[/b]. Play it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544550/Guidelicious/]right here[/url], and be sure to collect all the achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780352/df6651fc33ea6d6e482afe513b9a6f8709be84c6.png[/img]

[i]Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all your support, it truly means the world to us!

[b]Tymedust[/b][/i]

notes.title: Pitstop in Purgatory is getting a SEQUEL... and you can play it NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

This is [b]Tymedust[/b] reporting to you, all the awesome people who have given this game a chance by buying it here on Steam. Currently we've got a [b]Summer sale[/b] going on, so be sure to spread that around if you have any friends who might be interested in taking the plunge. :)

And now, some [i]very fun news[/i]... [b]check this out![/b]

[previewyoutube=skb6bNKmmJw;full][/previewyoutube]

Isobel Salvie seems to have everything; youth, beauty, wealth... unfortunately, none of that matters much when you're dead, poisoned by an unknown person for equally unknown reasons. Arriving in Heaven, Isobel is greeted by God herself. All seems well, because as it turns out, Paradise is wonderful.

However, the afterlife's pleasures don't come for free...

[b]Poetry in Purgatory[/b] is a unique, ever-evolving story about what it means to live, love and make peace with things you can't run away from... even when you may desperately want to.

Experience the prologue, full first act and the entire Bliss Alwes character route in version 0.1 of the game. And then be sure to check back regularly as the game receives frequent updates, adding new routes and story content for free! [i]Don't worry, there will be no need to replay old content for returning players.[/i]

---

That's right, [b]Pitstop in Purgatory[/b] is getting a standalone sequel - [b]Poetry in Purgatory[/b] - and in fact... [url=https://tymedust.itch.io/poetry-in-purgatory]it's out NOW on itchio[/url]. Well, kinda. You see, we're going episodic this time around, or rather... incorporating a sort of live service feel to it (although for a single-player game, of course). :)

The game is absolutely free, as will all the many upcoming content updates be. Then, once it's eventually completed, it will get a full retail release (Steam included, of course). Until then, however, you're more than welcome to join our journey by checking out the game in its current state. We're very excited about working with the community to make this game as special as it possibly can be!

As before, we're entirely self-financing this project, based solely on our passion for the universe we're creating. So if you enjoy our work, consider visiting our [url=https://www.patreon.com/Tymedust]Patreon[/url] where you can help us in development while also receiving some real cool benefits!

But enough talk, [strike]have at you[/strike] here's the [i]current[/i] game features:

[list]
[*] [b]Enter[/b] a truly memorable story currently consisting of 56k+ words, with a morality system that determines key traits of the main character, Isobel.
[*] [b]Explore[/b] the interactive world of Purgatory through a day-night cycle with four segments per day... lots of stuff to click on (or not, if you don't want to).
[*] [b]Play[/b] your way! Commit fully to the story or partake in as many character routes as you desire, and watch as their outcomes change the main narrative in meaningful ways.
[*] [b]Twist[/b] your mind as you uncover a myriad of plot threads, all carried by an afterlife setting as rich in lore as it is in pure, unadulterated fun.
[*] [b]Marvel[/b] at sprites, backgrounds, special scenes and inventory items all drawn in a beautiful and unique style.
[*] [b]Unlock[/b] 50+ hidden items, including database entries and gallery images.
[*] [b]Bop[/b] your head to a dynamic soundtrack composed by popular YouTube artist Endigo.
[/list]

As well as a list of upcoming [i]planned[/i] features:

[list]
[*] [b]Fleshed out world[/b]: Purgatory grows each day! Frequent, smaller updates will bring new interactions, side quests and artwork to existing characters and their routes.
[*] [b]Major story updates[/b]: Expect 3 full story acts loaded with twists and turns, as well as a monumental epilogue where your choices will be put to the ultimate test.
[*] [b]Major route updates[/b]: Bliss Alwes's route will be joined by 7 others for a grand total of 8 characters that you may romance... or choose to stay friends with. Romancing several characters at once is also a possibility!
[*] [b]Godly missions[/b]: Undertake optional content that will reward you with special scenes which are otherwise unattainable.
[*] [b]Achievements[/b]: Show off your Purgatorian efforts to your fellow Dwellers and Denizens. Coming very soon (and more will be added over time)!
[/list]

We're hoping that you'll join us for this next exciting chapter of the [b]Purgatoryverse[/b]. :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617228/f6d8b513fa733f2a3ac8dfb594be540cc8934cbd.png[/img]

[b]Have a fantastic Summer and thank you for the support... it means the world to us![/b]

And hey, if you want a place to talk about our games, and visual novels in general... we'd love to have you [url=https://discord.gg/KPjpVfZhfS]join our Discord[/url]! <3

Love,

[b]Tymedust[/b]
